title: [SPECFLOW] IMPROVE-02: ImprovementContract and evidence-strength model
body:
Epic: #171 · Story: IMPROVE-02 · Declared tier: `spec:thin`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-02-1: Implementation cannot start without a persisted contract and baseline or an explicit blocker explaining why no baseline can be established.
- [ ] AC-02-2: Acceptance and non-goals are frozen before builder execution; later edits create a new contract version and cannot retroactively make a failed change pass.
- [ ] AC-02-3: Every evidence item records its level, source/reference and applicable acceptance criterion.
- [ ] AC-02-4: Missing deterministic evidence remains missing; heuristic/model judgment cannot silently satisfy a deterministic requirement.
- [ ] AC-02-5: The contract remains small and scoped to the selected candidate rather than becoming a full-product specification.
